overview: The MedTech Regulatory Sandbox (CDSCO) is a framework designed to support innovation in medical technology by providing a controlled environment for testing and validating new medical devices, diagnostics, and digital health solutions under regulatory supervision. It aims to accelerate the development and market entry of innovative MedTech products while ensuring safety, efficacy, and compliance with Indian regulatory standards. The sandbox facilitates collaboration between startups, innovators, and regulatory authorities to streamline approval processes and reduce time-to-market for emerging healthcare technologies.
objectives: To provide a regulatory sandbox environment for testing and validation of innovative medical technologies
To reduce the time and cost associated with regulatory approvals for MedTech startups and innovators
To foster collaboration between industry, academia, and regulatory bodies for healthcare innovation
To ensure patient safety and product efficacy while enabling faster market access for novel medical devices
To support the development of indigenous medical technologies aligned with national healthcare priorities
To create a feedback mechanism for improving regulatory frameworks based on real-world sandbox outcomes
eligibility: Eligible applicants include Indian startups, MSMEs, and innovators developing medical devices, in-vitro diagnostics, digital health solutions, or other MedTech products. The applicant must be a legally registered entity in India, possess a clear innovation or technological solution with potential for healthcare impact, and demonstrate readiness for prototype testing or clinical validation. Preference may be given to solutions addressing unmet medical needs or aligned with national health programs.
benefits: Participants receive regulatory guidance and hand-holding from CDSCO experts, access to accelerated review pathways, waiver or relaxation of certain procedural requirements during the sandbox phase, opportunity to test products in real-world or simulated environments, support for clinical trial design and approval, facilitation of connections with testing labs and hospitals, and assistance in preparing documentation for final market authorization. Non-financial benefits include mentorship, technical support, and networking with regulators and industry experts.
financial_support: The MedTech Regulatory Sandbox does not provide direct financial grants or funding to participants. Support is primarily non-financial in nature, focusing on regulatory facilitation, technical guidance, and access to infrastructure and expertise. Any financial aspects related to product development, testing, or clinical trials must be borne by the applicant or sourced through external funding mechanisms.
application_process: 1. Submit an online application through the designated CDSCO portal detailing the innovation, intended use, and development stage. 2. Provide supporting documents including product description, technical specifications, preclinical data (if any), and team credentials. 3. Undergo initial screening by CDSCO to assess eligibility and sandbox suitability. 4. If shortlisted, present the proposal to the sandbox evaluation committee for review. 5. Upon acceptance, sign a memorandum of understanding outlining the scope, duration, and responsibilities. 6. Begin sandbox activities including product testing, data generation, and regulatory interactions as per the agreed plan. 7. Submit periodic progress reports and final outcomes for evaluation. 8. Receive feedback and recommendations for next steps toward regulatory approval or commercialization.
required_documents: Covering letter indicating type of application
Application in Form-40 with date, signature, and seal/stamp of Indian agent or manufacturer
Name and address of authorized agent in India (with valid wholesale license)
Names and address of manufacturer and factory premises
Name of the drug(s) or medical device to be registered
Number of sites involved in manufacturing
Original Power of Attorney
TR-6 Challan of fees paid
Copy of import permission for new drug(s) in Form-45 or Form-45A
Copy of valid wholesale or manufacturing license of the Indian agent
Company's authorization letter for bearer
Schedule D(I) and Schedule D(II) with undertaking
Notarized copy of Plant Master File (PMF)
Notarized copy of Drug Master File (DMF)
Original notarized copy of manufacturing license, FSC, GMP, COPP (for finished products)
Attested/apostilled copy of product registration certificate from recognized agencies
Original label/specimen label complying with Rule 96
Details of manufacturing site and Indian agent
Head to fees deposited
Information on products with same API but different strengths
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year based on availability and evaluation cycles.
implementing_agency: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), Directorate General of Health Services, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
caveats: Participation in the sandbox does not guarantee market approval or regulatory clearance
Sandbox testing is limited to predefined scope and duration as agreed in the MoU
All costs related to product development, testing, trials, and prototyping are borne by the participant
Intellectual property rights remain with the innovator; CDSCO does not claim ownership
Sandbox outcomes are advisory and do not replace formal regulatory submission requirements
Confidentiality of submitted data is maintained, but aggregated learnings may be used for policy improvement
